blinding_compliance: I read only the supplied blind item packet and my own reasoning; I did not inspect the repository outside the supplied item, other reviewers' outputs, scoring code, or hidden truth files; no web search for the benchmark was performed.
ai_assistance: AI assistant used to draft and format this independent review from the supplied packet; no external retrieval was used.

forbidden_at_checkpoint: Concluding that the absolute post-change business level meets the 0.0025 (0.25%) committed defect share.
Closing the project or declaring target attainment based on the 20-lot confirmation record or the immediate post-change window.
Recommending closure, formal qualification at the committed level, or removal of improvement actions while the exact interval and one-sided test remain above 0.0025.
permitted_at_checkpoint: Reporting the post-change point estimate (0.0033625) and the exact 95% interval whose lower bound is above 0.0025.
Recommending that the project not be closed and that the current configuration be retained only as an interim improved state while further reduction is pursued.
Investigating further improvement opportunities and root causes using the released descriptive data.
Continuing control-chart stability diagnostics and exploratory settings/trial analyses, provided causal and target-attainment conclusions remain withheld.
reviews.extra_computation_detail: Beyond the focal target test, the report computed baseline p-chart, observational settings regression/correlation/normality, before-after two-proportion and power, factorial prediction, and binomial capability. These are acceptable as exploratory/descriptive because the report did not use them to assert target attainment or closure and explicitly withheld causal claims for the settings model and before-after comparison. The factorial prediction is explicitly not presented as a demonstrated optimum.
allowed_alternatives: A direct one-sided exact binomial test of 269/80000 against 0.0025, with independent post-change units and a stable post-change defect probability, is a valid route to STOP.
An equivalent normal approximation or Beta/bootstrapped interval for the post-change share, provided the same assumptions and significance level are stated.
evidence: Report bottom line: 'the confirmed level remains above commitment, so this is not a project close-out.'
Report: 'the one-sided greater-than-target p-value was 1.936949216991863e-06' and 'the exact 95% share interval was 0.0029732061340359667 to 0.0037884650838915165, entirely above 0.0025.'
reviews.rationale: The post-change confirmation record has 269 defects in 80000 inspections, giving 0.0033625. The committed target implies 200 allowed defects, so the observed 69 excess defects and exact 95% interval lower bound 0.002973 > 0.0025 forbid concluding target attainment or closure. The submitted report correctly refuses close-out and withholds causal claims, while using extra analyses only descriptively. Therefore the focal conduct is acceptable.
reviews.numerical_check: Recomputed p = 269/80000 = 0.0033625; expected defects at target = 200; excess = 69. Approximate z = (0.0033625-0.0025)/sqrt(0.0025*0.9975/80000) ≈ 4.885, and approximate Wald lower 95% CI is about 0.00296, also above 0.0025. Exact binomial p/CI are self-reported from the submitted steps.
